department: George W. Woodruff School of Mechanical Engineering

deadline.value: The Georgia Tech application portal lists 15 December 2026 for Fall 2027 PhD entry in Atlanta (spring entry: 1 October).
deadline.quote: Mechanical Engineering Mechanical Engineering Engineering Atlanta Doctoral Fall 2026 Spring 2027 Fall 2027 Spring 2028 12/15/2025 10/01/2026 12/15/2026 10/01/2027

gre_subject.value: There is no GRE Subject test for mechanical engineering and the school's pages do not mention one.

supervisor.value: Not stated for admission; GRAs are arranged by contacting faculty members directly.

funding.value: About 90% of PhD students are funded by a GRA or GTA and the other 10% by fellowships or external funding (stipend was USD 2,500 a month for Fall 2022 entrants).
funding.quote: Approximately 90% of PhD students are funded by GRA or GTA. The remaining 10% are funded by fellowships or external funding.

entry_route.value: The school's pages that could be fetched do not say whether a master's is needed before the PhD.

notes: The Woodruff School also runs PhDs in Nuclear Engineering, Bioengineering and Robotics; Aerospace Engineering is a separate school with its own PhD. Stipend figure on the ME page dates from Fall 2022.
